findings.title: Content Security Policy (CSP)
findings.evidence: No content-security-policy header was observed in the final response.
findings.recommendation: Define a CSP suited to the application; begin with report-only mode if needed.

findings.title: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
findings.evidence: Final response URL is not HTTPS.
findings.recommendation: HSTS is delivered over HTTPS; configure HTTPS first, then review HSTS.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.evidence: No x-content-type-options header was observed in the final response.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy
findings.evidence: No referrer-policy header was observed in the final response.
findings.recommendation: Set a deliberate Referrer-Policy, such as strict-origin-when-cross-origin, based on application needs.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.evidence: No permissions-policy header was observed in the final response.
findings.recommendation: Consider restricting browser features that the application does not need.

findings.title: Framing protection
findings.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor a CSP frame-ancestors directive was observed.
findings.recommendation: If the site should not be embedded by arbitrary origins, configure CSP frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options.

findings.title: CORS configuration
findings.evidence: The server reflected the test origin: https://scanner-test.invalid.
findings.recommendation: Check whether origin reflection is restricted to an explicit allowlist and whether sensitive endpoints use credentials.

limitations: Only one GET request and one OPTIONS request are sent; this is not a crawler.
The scanner does not test authentication, authorization, application logic, injection, or exploitability.
Header presence is not proof that a policy is correctly configured.
CORS behavior may vary by endpoint and request; manual review is required.
Run only against systems you own or have explicit permission to assess.
